y6a3062d8c90.add: - **JIMEX-18:** **3rd edition** of the Japan-India Maritime Exercise, **Visakhapatnam, October 2018** (JIMEX began 2012).

y9eb04e6aefa.add: - **UN system expenditure by function (2018):** development assistance, humanitarian assistance, peace operations (peacekeeping), global agenda and specialised assistance – **'banking assistance' is not** a category.

y9cc64c98213.add: - **League of Nations:** created by the **Treaty of Versailles (Covenant), 1919**; began work **10 January 1920**, Geneva; dissolved April 1946 – India an original member.

y95946b01499.add: - **UNGA sessions** are numbered from 1946: **74th** – September 2019; 80th – September 2025; 81st – September 2026.

ycc416c11b67.add: - **UNESCO languages:** the General Conference uses **six** languages (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian, Spanish) – 'more than three'; the Secretariat's working languages are English and French.

y616e8d1a53e.add: - **WHO's primary role** (Constitution Art. 2): to act as the **directing and coordinating authority on international health work**, foster technical cooperation and promote research.

y6920e39633f.add: - **US withdrawals from UNESCO:** 1984; **2017 (effective 2018) citing anti-Israel bias**, arrears and need for reform; rejoined 2023; announced withdrawal again July 2025 (effective Dec 2026).

y8c479bf143d.add: - **UNEP Executive Director:** **Inger Andersen** (Denmark), from 2019, earlier Director General of **IUCN**; term to 2027.

y39c788cc138.add: - **Jim Yong Kim** – World Bank President **2012-2019** (the answer in older papers); then David Malpass (2019-23), **Ajay Banga** (from June 2023).

y99d52980364.add: - **PRGF** (Poverty Reduction and Growth Facility, 1999; now the PRGT) was set up by the **IMF**, not IDA; the **Singapore Regional Training Institute (STI)** is one of the **IMF's regional training centres**.

y90aca47e090.add: - **IBRD Articles** came into force on **27 December 1945** (with the IMF's) – hence '1945' as the World Bank's establishment year in keys; it began operations in June 1946.

y1230c850599.add: - **India** is an **original (founding) member** of the IMF – a member from **27 December 1945**.

y9df2ff9c8e5.add: - **IMFC** (International Monetary and Financial Committee): discusses concerns affecting the global economy and **advises the IMF** on the direction of its work; the **World Bank participates as an observer**.

y604220f1f9d.add: - **IMF** and **IFAD** are also **UN specialised agencies** – so IBRD, IFC, IFAD and IMF are all UN agencies.

y837b007c300.add: - **Krishna Srinivasan** – Director, **IMF Asia and Pacific Department** (from 2022).
